title: The For You Data Hub: a research data toolbox for studying user experiences of algorithmically curated short-video platforms
description:
The For You Data Hub turns participants' short-video data donations into analyzable research datasets about algorithmically curated feeds. It ingests the "Download Your Data" exports that TikTok, Instagram and YouTube provide to their users, enriches every watched item with scraped metadata, media and structured multimodal AI annotation, and merges the result into per-study datasets for cross-sectional and temporal analysis.

The object of study is short-form vertical video: the TikTok feed, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

Enrichment is governed by four declarative, versioned schema contracts, so every ingested, scraped or annotated row carries the hash-identified contract version that produced it. Annotation and embedding run on hosted or local open-weight models interchangeably, and ship with A/B evaluation and human intercoder-reliability harnesses for validating machine labels.

See CHANGELOG.md in the repository for the full contents of this release.
